suitability.rationale: Directly proposes biochemical inhibition measurement for P78527 and limits interpretation to biochemical activity. Assay compatibility still requires validation.
response_quotes: Luminescence proportional to ADP generated by kinase activity
The design measures biochemical inhibition only; it does not address cellular potency or off‑target effects.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Preparation, reaction, ATP depletion/detection and analysis are coherently ordered with vehicle/background controls. Essential enzyme/substrate conditions and volumes remain unresolved; linearity and readout interference are not validated. This is an outline rather than a supported executable procedure.
response_quotes: Terminate the kinase reaction, deplete remaining ATP, add ADP‑Glo detection reagents, and measure luminescence.
Enzyme concentration and substrate concentration are unresolved; optimization may be required to stay within the linear range of the assay.

numerical_soundness.rationale: The series is internally consistent but justified only by generic practice. The supplied 10 µM ATP value concerns a radioactive assay and does not establish transferability. Timing assumptions include unsupported protocol attributions, and fit acceptance thresholds lack justification.
response_quotes: 100 µM (assumption; typical upper range for initial screening)
10 µM (evidence from retained assay CHEMBL1243970 describing DNA‑PK inhibition with 10 µM ATP)

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of recombinant DNA-PK catalytic subunit, unspecified peptide substrate and ADP-Glo under the proposed conditions.
Comparability of the radioactive 10 µM ATP assay to the proposed luminescence assay.
Optimal enzyme/substrate amounts, reaction/detection conditions, compound solubility and DMSO tolerance are not supplied.
assumption_handling: Most unsupported settings are explicitly assumptions or unresolved. However, assay compatibility and ATP transfer are asserted too confidently. Per ADP-Glo protocol wording has no supplied protocol support despite the assumption label. Fit thresholds lack support or assumption labels, and triplicates are not identified as technical or independent.

numeric_check.notes: Eight concentrations run from 100 to 0.0457247 µM (45.7247 nM). No conflicting endpoint or list is supplied. Replicate independence is unspecified.

review_reason: Review unresolved assay compatibility and activation/operating conditions, ATP transfer, readout controls and numerical acceptance criteria.
